name: stm32f051
description: ST STM32F051x8 / STM32F030x8 (Cortex-M0 48 MHz, 64 KB flash, 8 KB SRAM, USART1-2, SPI1-2, I2C1-2, TIM1/2/3/6/14/15/16/17, ADC, DAC, touch sensing): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeF0 HAL/LL, Renode stm32f051 platform

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32F051R8Tx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32f051x8.s (STM32F030x8: -DSTM32F030x8, startup_stm32f030x8.s) from a Cube example (Projects/STM32F030R8-Nucleo/Templates or STM32F0-Discovery). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree; CubeIDE board projects build with `embeddyn mechatronics import`.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_f030r8.repl (STM32F030R8 runs on the F051 platform: LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2) and platforms/boards/st/stm32f0_discovery.repl (LD3 PC9 = ld3, LD4 PC8 = ld4, B1 PA0). The RCC clock tree (HSI/HSE/HSI48, PREDIV, PLL, HPRE, PPRE) drives SysTick and every timer. DMA requests go to their default channels (no SYSCFG remap). EXTI lines take the port SYSCFG_EXTICR selects. ADC: 'adc SetVoltage microvolts channel'. DAC channel 1 ('dac OutputVoltage 0'), TIM6 TRGO trigger. Touch: 'tsc Touch group io true'. Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeF0 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_f051.txt in the Renode tree)
